channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-vba
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Leandro Ascierto's website — via awesome-vba
item.description: Full of low-level examples of using VBA and VB6. The original site closed in September 2026; this thread hosts the archive. Download: https://mega.nz/file/iIIBUCiI#l8fVsNtrhXOuBZtrkSNrdBWEVLSYp3scVnCQELs1bgI.

item.title: vbaImageSearch — via awesome-vba
item.description: Find a bitmap on screen or inside another image, with optional colour tolerance.

item.title: X64Bridge — via awesome-vba
item.description: Call 64-bit DLLs from 32-bit VB6/VBA on 64-bit Windows using the WOW64 segment trick.

item.title: VbaPcre2 — via awesome-vba
item.description: PCRE2 regular-expression wrapper for 32- and 64-bit VBA, with a separate DLL for Win32 and Win64.

item.title: VBANN — via awesome-vba
item.description: A machine learning framework for training neural networks inside an Excel workbook, with an optional OpenBLAS speedup.

item.title: TaskbarExtensionsVBA — via awesome-vba
item.description: Pure VBA control of Windows taskbar progress, overlay icons, jump lists, and thumbnail buttons. No external DLL. Thumbnail clicks need 64-bit Office.

item.title: Space Shooter — via awesome-vba
item.description: A 120 FPS 2D space shooter in pure VBA and WinAPI GDI. Also check out the video.

item.title: ROneCOne — via awesome-vba
item.description: A dependency-free C#-style framework for Windows x64 Excel: LINQ, tasks, data tables, and JSON in one class module.

item.title: Office Icons Gallery — via awesome-vba
item.description: Searchable gallery of Microsoft Office icons for building ribbon interfaces.

item.title: ChibiPDF — via awesome-vba
item.description: Dependency-free PDF text extraction, OCR, and page rendering for Windows 10+.

item.title: ChibiArc — via awesome-vba
item.description: Read and write ZIP, 7-Zip, TAR, CAB, and ISO via built-in archiveint.dll (64-bit, Windows 10+).

item.title: ZipArchive — via awesome-vba
item.description: A single-class pure VB6 library for zip with ASM speed. Compatible with 32-bit VBA and Twinbasic.

item.title: VBE_Colours — via awesome-vba
item.description: A small external utility to configure the colours of the VBE editor. Not open-source, but its Github presence provides additional information.

item.title: The VBA Help — via awesome-vba
item.description: A site dedicated to VBA with a large number of instructive blog posts. Written by the author of VBE_Extras, an AddIn for the VBA IDE and VBE_Colours, a small utility to configure the available colors used by the VBA IDE.

item.title: SHA256 — via awesome-vba
item.description: A repository of cryptographic primitives implemented in VBx and compatible with VB6, both 32- and 64-bit VBA and TwinBasic.

item.title: MS Access VCS Addin — via awesome-vba
item.description: Synchronize Access Forms, Macros, Modules, Queries, Reports, and more with a version control system for MS Access.
